character: Wolf Heimlich and Olympia Myklos discussing his scars
voice: Historically grounded Heidelberg fencing, rigid vanity, mutual flirtation, and quiet ambition without faux-German spelling.

entries.text: Wolfie, your facial scars are magnificent! How did you get them?
Academic fencing, my dear. At Heidelberg, we stood at fixed distance and traded cuts. These scars were considered badges of courage.
How fascinating! You did not wear masks to protect your faces?
No. Such protection was considered unmanly.
You will have to teach me sometime.
There are many disciplines I could teach you, my dear.
Perhaps we should go somewhere less public, Wolfie.
Agreed--especially with that reporter prowling through the museum. If I were in command, she would never have been admitted.
Give it time, Wolfie. Perhaps you will be in command someday, if I have anything to say about it.
Oh? And how would you arrange that?
There are ways. Come; we should discuss them in private.
